title: Hope for pleasure without matching enthusiasm

captions.physics: Continuing a shared trial with gentleness
captions.emotions: Feeling hope for an enjoyable continuation

meaning: A shared idea can sustain hope when gentleness leaves each a free response instead of requiring proof of identical desire.
text: A gentle beginning can support enjoyment still taking shape. Strength in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps you experiment calmly without pressuring each other through awkwardness. The Lovers in energy lean towards confirmation of matching wishes. The Star in emotions allows hope for a pleasant continuation. It can remain warm without promising equal enthusiasm from both. Hope serves shared joy when accompanying free experience, beyond requiring each to confirm the whole future idea beforehand. A good beginning need not already decide the pace or form of everything that may follow.

Suppose you try singing a favourite refrain together. You stumble, laugh and begin again, before one wants to stop and preserve the pleasant moment. **Hope for continuation leaves permission to finish today.** You can enjoy what happened and freely decide about returning later. Gentleness requires no endless readiness to repeat. The idea keeps a future without immediately receiving a timetable or a guarantee of identical enthusiasm at identical times.

The difficulty is hearing a calm refusal of another attempt as lost hope. You persuade, try to be patient and increasingly await the right reaction instead of enjoyment. A free idea grows too weighty. Hope supports closeness when another pace is permitted. A small good experience can end while preserving freedom to want more later, beyond making today’s answer a final conclusion about affection or shared interest.
